title: 什么是生物安保（国内版）
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/15_What is biosecurity biosecurity biosafety laboratory.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/15_What is biosecurity biosecurity biosafety laboratory（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 生物安保：一套保护措施
points.K2: 护人、护动物、护植物、护环境
points.S1: 中文的“生物安全”管得更宽
points.S2: 实验生物不放生，不乱丢
points.S3: 发现异常病死动物：报告，不碰

shots.scene: 欣欣站在校园里，身后是实验楼、农田和小河
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands on a campus path with a lab building, a field and a small river behind it, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到生物安全课。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一面带锁头图案的盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a shield with a padlock icon on it.
shots.narration: 今天说一个词：生物安保。

shots.scene: 阿杰从实验室端着一盒用剩的果蝇往外走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a small closed box of leftover fruit fly vials out of the lab toward the campus garden.
shots.narration: 阿杰做完实验，剩下一盒果蝇。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在花园边，打算打开盒子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at the edge of the garden about to open the box.
shots.narration: 他想：放到花园里，也算放生吧？

shots.scene: 小研赶来按住盒子，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over and puts her hand on the box, shaking her head.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧拦住：这可不行。

shots.scene: 欣欣出现在两人中间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot appears between the two of them with a friendly smile.
shots.narration: 为什么不行？从生物安保说起。

shots.section_title: 生物安保：一套保护措施
shots.scene: 一本空白规程手册和一个清单图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure manual next to a checklist icon and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安保，是一整套措施和规程。
overlay: 生物安保：一套保护措施

shots.section_title: 生物安保：一套保护措施
shots.scene: 盾牌把一圈微生物和虫子图标挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: A shield blocking a ring of microbe and insect icons from reaching a small house. No people.
shots.narration: 目的只有一个：保护。

shots.section_title: 护人、护动物、护植物、护环境
shots.scene: 四个图标依次亮起：人、牛羊、麦穗、山水
shots.prompt_en: Four icons light up one by one: a person, a cow and a sheep, a wheat stalk, and mountains with a river. No people.
shots.narration: 保护谁？人、动物、植物和环境。
overlay: 护人、护动物、护植物、护环境

shots.section_title: 护人、护动物、护植物、护环境
shots.scene: 人形图标旁边有温度计
shots.prompt_en: A person outline next to a thermometer and a medicine cup. No people.
shots.narration: 人会被传染生病，

shots.section_title: 护人、护动物、护植物、护环境
shots.scene: 养殖场的牛羊和农田的庄稼图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a farm with cattle and sheep beside a field of crops. No people.
shots.narration: 动物会得疫病，庄稼会遭病虫害，

shots.section_title: 护人、护动物、护植物、护环境
shots.scene: 河流和森林图标，一只陌生的虫子正在扩散
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a river and a forest where an unfamiliar insect species spreads across the map. No people.
shots.narration: 环境也会被外来生物破坏。

shots.scene: 三个图标：细菌病毒、害虫、毒素液滴
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a microbe and virus particle, a pest insect, and a toxin droplet. No people.
shots.narration: 要防的，是有害的生物因子，

shots.scene: 放大镜下的病原体图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a cartoon pathogen icon. No people.
shots.narration: 比如让人和动物生病的病原体，

shots.scene: 啃食叶片的害虫和杂草图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pest insect chewing a leaf and an invasive weed. No people.
shots.narration: 破坏庄稼的害虫，

shots.scene: 密封瓶上的骷髅象形图
shots.prompt_en: A sealed vial with a skull and crossbones pictogram on a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 还有生物产生的毒素。

shots.scene: 地图上一个红点向外扩散成一片
shots.prompt_en: A simple map with one red dot spreading outward into a large red area. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安保要防两件事。

shots.scene: 边境线上的门挡住带病菌图标的箱子
shots.prompt_en: A gate at a border line stops a box marked with a microbe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一是防外面的有害生物传进来，

shots.scene: 一圈隔离线把红点围在中间
shots.prompt_en: A ring-shaped barrier line surrounds a red dot and stops it from spreading. No people.
shots.narration: 二是防已有的扩散出去。

shots.scene: 传染病、入侵物种、生物威胁三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a sick person with a thermometer, an invasive insect, and a warning triangle with a biohazard sign. No people.
shots.narration: 传染病、入侵物种、生物威胁都算。

shots.scene: 三个来源图标：云朵树叶、打翻的试管、问号人影
shots.prompt_en: Three source icons: a cloud with leaves, a tipped-over test tube, and a shadowy figure with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这些危害从哪来？有三种情况。

shots.scene: 候鸟飞过湖面的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of migrating birds flying over a lake. No people.
shots.narration: 自然发生的，比如候鸟带来的疫病；

shots.scene: 打翻的试管和逃出的小虫图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tipped-over culture tube and small insects escaping from an open box. No people.
shots.narration: 意外发生的，比如实验生物逃逸；

shots.scene: 锁着的冷冻柜和监控图标
shots.prompt_en: A locked freezer with a padlock beside a security camera icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有人蓄意滥用，所以要管牢。

shots.scene: 欣欣双手比出一个大圈
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot spreads its arms to make a big circle.
shots.narration: 不管哪一种，都在防范之列。

shots.section_title: 中文的“生物安全”管得更宽
shots.scene: 一本空白法律书，封面只有盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank law book with only a shield icon on the cover. No people.
shots.narration: 在我国，用词要注意。
overlay: 中文的“生物安全”管得更宽

shots.section_title: 中文的“生物安全”管得更宽
shots.scene: 大圆圈里装着多个小图标：疫情、实验室、入侵物种、生物恐怖
shots.prompt_en: A large circle containing smaller icons: an epidemic map, a lab building, an invasive insect, and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全法里的生物安全，范围很宽，

shots.section_title: 中文的“生物安全”管得更宽
shots.scene: 大圆里的一个小圆被点亮：实验室
shots.prompt_en: Inside the large circle, the small lab building icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室生物安全，只是其中一块。

shots.section_title: 中文的“生物安全”管得更宽
shots.scene: 实验室图标里分出两半：盾牌和锁头
shots.prompt_en: The lab icon splits into two halves: a shield for accidents and a padlock for misuse. No people.
shots.narration: 防意外暴露，也防丢失和滥用。

shots.section_title: 实验生物不放生，不乱丢
shots.scene: 阿杰把果蝇盒交给小研
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands the box of fruit fly vials to the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 回到阿杰的果蝇。
overlay: 实验生物不放生，不乱丢

shots.section_title: 实验生物不放生，不乱丢
shots.scene: 向花园、河流放生实验生物的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of releasing lab insects into a garden and lab fish into a river, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验动物、昆虫、植物不能放生，

shots.section_title: 实验生物不放生，不乱丢
shots.scene: 转基因植物种子撒在路边的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of lab seeds being scattered by a roadside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 种子、菌株也不能随手带出去。

shots.section_title: 实验生物不放生，不乱丢
shots.scene: 小研把果蝇盒放进灭菌袋，送进高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places the closed box into an autoclave bag with a biohazard sign and loads it into an autoclave.
shots.narration: 按规定灭活处理，再当废物处置。

shots.section_title: 发现异常病死动物：报告，不碰
shots.scene: 阿杰在校园草地上看到一只死去的鸟
shots.prompt_en: On a campus lawn, the young male student notices a dead bird lying on the grass and stops.
shots.narration: 生活里也能做生物安保。
overlay: 发现异常病死动物：报告，不碰

shots.section_title: 发现异常病死动物：报告，不碰
shots.scene: 徒手捡起死鸟的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand picking up a dead bird, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 看到异常死亡的动物，别用手碰，

shots.section_title: 发现异常病死动物：报告，不碰
shots.scene: 阿杰拍照后给保卫处打电话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student keeps his distance, takes a photo with his phone, then calls the security officer.
shots.narration: 记下位置，报告学校相关部门。

shots.section_title: 发现异常病死动物：报告，不碰
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员和老李戴手套带工具赶来
shots.prompt_en: The security officer and the facility engineer arrive wearing gloves and carrying a sealed container.
shots.narration: 由专业人员来处理。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在四个图标前：人、动物、植物、环境
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of four icons: a person, animals, a plant and a river landscape.
shots.narration: 生物安保保护人、动物、植物、环境。

shots.scene: 传入、扩散两个箭头被盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: Two arrows labelled only with icons, one coming in and one spreading out, both blocked by shields. No people.
shots.narration: 防有害生物传进来、扩散开。

shots.scene: 自然、意外、蓄意三个图标都被圈住
shots.prompt_en: The nature, accident and misuse icons are all enclosed by one protective ring. No people.
shots.narration: 自然、意外、蓄意，都要防。

shots.scene: 阿杰点头，把空盒子放回实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods and returns the empty box to the lab shelf.
shots.narration: 实验生物不外放，发现异常就报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣、阿杰、小研在实验楼前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye in front of the lab building.
shots.narration: 守好实验室，也守好身边，下次见！
